nodes.label: alpha-Ketoglutarate
nodes.description: TCA-cycle intermediate produced by glutaminolysis; promotes GTP loading of RagB and lysosomal mTORC1 translocation, reportedly through prolyl hydroxylase activity.

nodes.label: Amino acids (pool)
nodes.description: Products of autophagolysosomal protein degradation that replenish lysosomal and cytosolic pools and reactivate mTORC1, making the autophagy-mTORC1 system oscillatory rather than switch-like.

nodes.label: Amino-acid starvation
nodes.description: Deprivation of one or more amino acids; beyond Rag/GATOR sensing it activates GCN2 via uncharged tRNA, driving ATF4-dependent Sestrin2 induction that sustains mTORC1 suppression.

nodes.label: Arginine
nodes.description: Amino acid sensed in the cytosol by CASTOR1 and in the lysosomal lumen by SLC38A9; both routes converge on the Rag heterodimer.

nodes.label: Cholesterol (lysosomal)
nodes.description: Lysosomal sterol pool that activates mTORC1 through an SLC38A9-NPC1 signalling complex; this arm is an emerging mechanism.

nodes.label: GDP
nodes.description: Guanine nucleotide whose binding to RagC/D is required for the active, mTORC1-recruiting configuration of the Rag heterodimer.

nodes.label: Glutamine
nodes.description: Most abundant free amino acid; signals to mTORC1 both through Rag-independent Arf1-dependent routes and through glutaminolytic production of alpha-ketoglutarate.

nodes.label: GTP
nodes.description: Guanine nucleotide whose binding to RagA/B produces the Raptor-binding competent state of the heterodimer.

nodes.label: Leucine
nodes.description: Branched-chain essential amino acid and the most potent single amino-acid activator of mTORC1; the ligand at the centre of the competing Sestrin2, LARS1, SAR1B and lysosomal-efflux sensing models.

nodes.label: Methionine
nodes.description: Essential amino acid and a well-established longevity-modifying dietary variable; signals to mTORC1 indirectly through its conversion to S-adenosylmethionine.

nodes.label: S-adenosylmethionine
nodes.description: Universal methyl donor whose cellular concentration tracks methionine availability; the direct ligand of SAMTOR.

nodes.label: NPRL2 loss-of-function variants
nodes.description: Loss-of-function NPRL2 variants removing the catalytic arginine-finger subunit of GATOR1, causing GATOR1-related focal epilepsy with cortical dysplasia.

nodes.label: Androgens
nodes.description: Testosterone/DHT; via the androgen receptor increase mTORC1 activity in prostate cancer cells; AR and PI3K–AKT are reciprocally cross-regulated in PTEN-deficient prostate cancer.

nodes.label: Estrogen (17β-estradiol)
nodes.description: Steroid hormone; via ERα engages non-genomic PI3K–AKT signalling and promotes survival/metastasis of TSC2-null cells (relevant to lymphangioleiomyomatosis).

nodes.label: IGF-1
nodes.description: Insulin-like growth factor 1; growth-hormone-dependent ligand of IGF-1R that activates PI3K–AKT and mTORC1 (muscle hypertrophy, growth).

nodes.label: Chronic inflammation
nodes.description: Inflammatory (NF-κB-axis) signalling that activates IKKβ, suppressing TSC1 and raising mTORC1 activity; proposed link between inflammation and anabolic dysregulation of ageing tissue.

nodes.label: Insulin
nodes.description: Pancreatic β-cell peptide hormone; principal physiological ligand of INSR, driving IRS–PI3K–AKT signalling to TSC2/PRAS40 and thus mTORC1.

nodes.label: Leptin
nodes.description: Adipose-derived satiety hormone whose anorectic action requires intact hypothalamic mTOR signalling.

nodes.label: Mechanical load
nodes.description: Resistance exercise / eccentric contraction / stretch; activates mTORC1 in muscle through PLD–PA, membrane perturbation and focal-adhesion signalling, largely independently of ERK and PI3K.

nodes.label: Resistance exercise / mechanical overload
nodes.description: Mechanical loading of skeletal muscle (resistance exercise, overload, chronic stimulation) that activates mTORC1 through phospholipase D-derived phosphatidic acid, membrane perturbation and focal adhesion signalling.

nodes.label: TNFα
nodes.description: Inflammatory cytokine that activates IKK-beta, which phosphorylates and suppresses TSC1, raising mTORC1 output; a molecular link between chronic inflammation and anabolic dysregulation.

nodes.label: TBC1D7 loss of function
nodes.description: Biallelic truncating TBC1D7 variants causing macrocephaly/megalencephaly with intellectual disability and elevated mTORC1 signalling in patient cells.

nodes.label: Wnt ligands
nodes.description: Canonical Wnt signalling inhibits GSK3, removing GSK3-dependent activation of TSC2 and thereby stimulating mTORC1 independently of β-catenin.

nodes.label: A-769662
nodes.description: Thienopyridone direct AMPK activator binding the ADaM site at the alpha-kinase/beta-CBM interface; beta1-selective; allosterically activates AMPK and protects Thr172 from dephosphorylation.

nodes.label: ADP
nodes.description: Adenosine diphosphate; binds AMPK gamma CBS sites and protects pThr172 from dephosphorylation without allosteric activation; physiologically relevant because cellular ADP exceeds AMP.

nodes.label: AICAR (acadesine)
nodes.description: Cell-permeable nucleoside converted to ZMP, an AMP mimetic that binds AMPK gamma and activates AMPK; classical experimental AMPK activator with known off-target effects.

nodes.label: AMP
nodes.description: Adenosine monophosphate; rises disproportionately when ATP falls (adenylate kinase equilibrium) and is the primary low-energy signal that allosterically activates AMPK and promotes net Thr172 phosphorylation.

nodes.label: ATP
nodes.description: Adenosine triphosphate; competes with AMP/ADP for AMPK gamma nucleotide sites, keeping AMPK inactive when energy charge is high.

nodes.label: Ca2+ (cytosolic calcium)
nodes.description: Lysosomal calcium released through TRPML1 into a local microdomain, activating calcineurin adjacent to the lysosomal surface.

nodes.label: Caloric restriction
nodes.description: Sustained reduction in energy intake that lowers mTORC1 signalling; its effect on hepatic mTOR signalling is time-of-day dependent, so feeding schedule confounds comparison between dietary-restriction studies.

nodes.label: DNA damage
nodes.description: Genotoxic stress (ionising radiation, etoposide, ROS) activating ATM/ATR-CHK2 and p53; p53 transcriptional targets (sestrins, REDD1, PTEN, TSC2, AMPK beta1) collectively suppress mTORC1.

nodes.label: Energy stress (high AMP/ATP)
nodes.description: Any state in which ATP consumption exceeds production (glucose deprivation, hypoxia, mitochondrial inhibition, exercise), raising AMP/ADP:ATP and engaging the LKB1-AMPK checkpoint on mTORC1.

nodes.label: ER stress (unfolded protein response)
nodes.description: Endoplasmic-reticulum stress; one of the two mechanisms (with suppressed autophagy) by which chronic mTORC1 hyperactivation drives beta-cell dedifferentiation and failure.

nodes.label: Exercise
nodes.description: Physical activity; endurance/contractile activity activates muscle AMPK (energy turnover), while resistance loading activates muscle mTORC1 through phosphatidic acid and mechanotransduction - opposite inputs by modality.

nodes.label: Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate
nodes.description: Glycolytic intermediate whose concentration reports glucose availability. FBP occupancy of aldolase prevents the apo-aldolase conformation that nucleates the lysosomal v-ATPase–Ragulator–AXIN–LKB1 platform, so falling FBP activates AMPK before any change in the AMP:ATP ratio.

nodes.label: Glucose
nodes.description: Principal energy substrate; glucose sufficiency is relayed to mTORC1 through Rag GTPases (largely AMPK-independent, DHAP proposed as the sensed glycolytic intermediate) and keeps AMPK inactive by sustaining ATP and FBP.

nodes.label: Glucose deprivation
nodes.description: Glucose withdrawal; activates AMPK through AMP/ADP rise and through an AMP-independent aldolase-FBP route at the lysosome, inhibits mTORC1 via Rag GTPases and HK2-Raptor binding, and induces REDD1 via ATF4.

nodes.label: Glycogen
nodes.description: Storage polysaccharide sensed directly by the carbohydrate-binding module of the AMPK β-subunit; branched glycogen with single α-1,6 branch points inhibits AMPK, coupling cellular carbohydrate reserves to the energy-sensing arm upstream of mTORC1.

nodes.label: Hypoxia
nodes.description: Low oxygen tension; inhibits mTORC1 through HIF-1-driven REDD1 induction and TSC activation, through AMPK activation secondary to falling ATP, and through BNIP3-Rheb binding.

nodes.label: Oxidative stress (ROS)
nodes.description: Reactive oxygen species (H2O2, mitochondrial ROS); activate cytoplasmic ATM-LKB1-AMPK, a peroxisomal TSC pool and AMPK (directly or via ATP depletion), collectively repressing mTORC1 and inducing autophagy.

nodes.label: STRADA biallelic loss of function
nodes.description: Homozygous 7-kb LYK5/STRADA deletion (Old Order Mennonite founder) or other biallelic loss; impairs LKB1-AMPK signalling and causes PMSE syndrome with neuronal mTORC1 hyperactivation.

nodes.label: Lysosomal stress
nodes.description: Lysosomal damage or stress that triggers TRPML1-mediated local calcium release and calcineurin-dependent TFEB dephosphorylation. Together with mTORC1 inhibition, it is a trigger of TFEB nuclear entry.

nodes.label: Light (photic input)
nodes.description: Photic signal reaching the suprachiasmatic nucleus via the retinohypothalamic tract; the dominant entraining stimulus for the central clock and an acute activator of SCN signalling cascades including mTORC1.

nodes.label: Sleep deprivation
nodes.description: Acute sleep loss

nodes.label: Bmal1 loss of function (Bmal1-null)
nodes.description: Germline deletion of Bmal1 in mice: arrhythmic behaviour, elevated mTORC1 activity in multiple tissues and premature ageing phenotypes whose lifespan cost is substantially corrected by rapamycin.

nodes.label: PER2 loss of function (Per2-null)
nodes.description: Per2-deficient allele; the genetic test of PER2-dependent restraint of mTORC1 reported with reference [662].

nodes.label: Ageing
nodes.description: Chronological ageing as an input: raises basal mTORC1 tone while attenuating acute responsiveness, impairs stress-responsive autophagy and drives immunosenescence.

nodes.label: Resistance exercise / mechanical overload
nodes.description: Mechanical loading of skeletal muscle; activates mTORC1 through phospholipase D-derived phosphatidic acid, membrane perturbation and focal adhesion signalling, and is the stimulus whose protein-synthetic response rapamycin blocks in humans.

nodes.label: Small-molecule mTORC2 activator
nodes.description: Unnamed small molecule reported in [280] to raise mTORC2 activity; enhances L-LTP and long-term memory in wild-type animals and reverses age-associated memory impairment in mice and flies.

nodes.label: Distal-network lesion class
nodes.description: Lesions raising flux into a branched network in which mTORC1 is one effector among several and AKT retains output to GSK3beta, FOXO and MDM2.

nodes.label: Proximal-brake lesion class
nodes.description: Lesions acting on or immediately above the kinase that remove a constitutive restraint and leave mTORC1 as the sole effector, creating genuine dependency.

nodes.label: DEPDC5 loss-of-function
nodes.description: Germline heterozygous loss-of-function variant in the GATOR1 component DEPDC5; in an open-label case series the three patients with DEPDC5 truncating/LoF variants responded to everolimus, whereas a DEPDC5 missense variant responded less and the single NPRL3 patient worsened.

nodes.label: MTOR E1799K
nodes.description: Recurrent germline MTOR gain-of-function substitution accounting for roughly half of Smith–Kingsmore syndrome cases.

nodes.label: MTOR gain-of-function (somatic mosaic)
nodes.description: Germline activating MTOR substitutions causing Smith–Kingsmore syndrome (E1799K accounts for roughly half of cases); patient variants dampen cellular circadian amplitude as well as driving overgrowth and epilepsy.

nodes.label: NPRL3 loss-of-function
nodes.description: Heterozygous germline loss of a GATOR1 subunit causing familial focal epilepsy; the single reported NPRL3 patient worsened on everolimus.

nodes.label: STK11 (LKB1) loss-of-function
nodes.description: Germline (Peutz-Jeghers syndrome) or somatic (lung adenocarcinoma, cervical cancer) STK11 inactivation; removes AMPK Thr172 phosphorylation under energy stress and deregulates mTORC1.

nodes.label: TSC1 loss-of-function
nodes.description: Loss-of-function alteration of TSC1, a proximal-brake lesion; identified in exceptional responders to everolimus in urothelial carcinoma and present in roughly 8% of bladder cancers.

nodes.label: TSC2 loss-of-function
nodes.description: Germline (+ second hit) or somatic TSC2 loss; abolishes Rheb GAP activity; tuberous sclerosis, LAM, PEComa (AMPECT response enriched); proximal-brake lesion.

nodes.label: Alpelisib
nodes.description: PI3K-alpha-selective inhibitor; SOLAR-1 demonstrated benefit in a population prospectively selected for PIK3CA mutation, an example of genomic selection succeeding upstream of the mTOR node.

nodes.label: Apitolisib
nodes.description: Dual class I PI3K and mTOR kinase inhibitor; clinical development limited by metabolic and general toxicity rather than by lack of target engagement.

nodes.label: AZD8055
nodes.description: Potent, selective, orally bioavailable ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor active against both complexes; the chemical precursor of vistusertib.

nodes.label: Capivasertib
nodes.description: ATP-competitive pan-AKT inhibitor; CAPItello-291 demonstrated benefit in AKT-pathway-altered breast cancer, the second upstream node at which genomic selection succeeded.

nodes.label: Cyclosporine A
nodes.description: Cyclic peptide immunosuppressant that binds cyclophilin A; the complex inhibits calcineurin. Comparator for the diabetogenic risk of mTOR inhibitors after transplantation.

nodes.label: Dactolisib
nodes.description: Imidazoquinoline dual pan-PI3K and mTOR kinase inhibitor developed partly to pre-empt feedback reactivation of AKT; limited clinically by a toxicity ceiling.

nodes.label: Dexamethasone (topical)
nodes.description: Corticosteroid used as a mouthwash to prevent rapalog-associated stomatitis (SWISH trial).

nodes.label: Everolimus
nodes.description: First-generation allosteric rapalog, a 40-O-(2-hydroxyethyl) derivative of sirolimus. Pharmacokinetics (node attributes, not edges): oral bioavailability approximately 30%, half-life near 30 h; CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein substrate, with brain accumulation restricted by ABCB1. Used at immunosuppressive and oncology exposures and, at much lower exposures (0.5 mg daily or 5 mg weekly), as an immunological geroscience intervention.

nodes.label: KU-0063794
nodes.description: Selective ATP-competitive mTOR tool inhibitor that blocks both complexes without inhibiting related PI3K-family kinases at comparable concentrations.

nodes.label: Metformin
nodes.description: Biguanide antidiabetic; inhibits mitochondrial complex I (raising AMP/ADP), binds PEN2 to activate lysosomal AMPK at low doses, and also inhibits mTORC1 independently of AMPK via Rag GTPases and p53-REDD1.

nodes.label: nab-Sirolimus
nodes.description: Nanoparticle albumin-bound intravenous formulation of sirolimus, approved for advanced malignant perivascular epithelioid cell tumour on the AMPECT trial, where response was enriched in TSC2-mutant tumours.

nodes.label: OSI-027
nodes.description: ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor with activity against mTORC1 and mTORC2; evaluated in early-phase oncology studies.

nodes.label: PP242
nodes.description: ATP-competitive mTOR active-site tool inhibitor used to define the rapamycin-resistant outputs of mTORC1 and mTORC2.

nodes.label: RapaLink-1
nodes.description: First bi-steric mTOR inhibitor: a rapamycin (FKBP12-binding) moiety tethered to an ATP-site moiety, achieving mTORC1 selectivity through FKBP12-mediated avidity and overcoming FRB resistance mutations.

nodes.label: Rapamycin (sirolimus)
nodes.description: First-generation allosteric rapalog. Binds FKBP12 with sub- to low-nanomolar affinity; the binary complex engages the FRB domain of assembled mTORC1. Pharmacokinetics (node attributes, not edges): oral bioavailability approximately 14% for the tablet formulation, terminal half-life near 62 h; CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein substrate; therapeutic drug monitoring with troughs typically 4-12 ng/mL in transplantation. Compounded rapamycin, widely used off-label, delivers substantially lower and more variable systemic exposure per milligram than the branded product, which is both a safety consideration and a major confounder in trials that used it. Off-label use for healthspan is not endorsed by any professional body.

nodes.label: Ridaforolimus
nodes.description: Non-prodrug rapalog with a phosphine oxide substituent at C43; investigated in sarcoma and other solid tumours but not approved.

nodes.label: RMC-5552
nodes.description: Bi-steric mTORC1-selective inhibitor that fully suppresses 4E-BP1; phase 1 reported a complete response in PTEN/PIK3CA-altered endometrial cancer with treatment-related hyperglycaemia in only 4% of patients.

nodes.label: RTB101
nodes.description: ATP-competitive PI3K/mTOR inhibitor (BEZ235/dactolisib) studied at low doses for immune function in older adults; the phase 3 respiratory-illness endpoint was not met.

nodes.label: Sapanisertib
nodes.description: Second-generation ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor active against both mTORC1 and mTORC2, including the rapamycin-resistant 4E-BP1 sites.

nodes.label: Tacrolimus (FK506)
nodes.description: Macrolide immunosuppressant that binds FKBP12; the FKBP12-FK506 complex inhibits calcineurin rather than mTOR. Also used topically as mouthwash prophylaxis against mTOR-inhibitor mucositis.

nodes.label: Temsirolimus
nodes.description: First-generation rapalog given intravenously as a prodrug converted to sirolimus. CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein substrate. Approved for advanced poor-prognosis renal cell carcinoma on the basis of the Global ARCC trial; also used as CCI-779 in preclinical neurodegeneration models.

nodes.label: Torin1
nodes.description: ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor that fully suppresses rapamycin-resistant 4E-BP1 Thr37/Thr46 phosphorylation and TOP mRNA translation.

nodes.label: Torin2
nodes.description: Second-generation ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor and tool compound

nodes.label: mTOR FRB resistance mutation
nodes.description: Substitutions in the FRB domain (the Ser2035 contact in the original yeast and mammalian studies; M2327I in a patient relapsing on a rapalog) that abolish FKBP12-rapamycin binding and confer resistance.

nodes.label: Vistusertib
nodes.description: Second-generation ATP-competitive mTOR kinase inhibitor from the AZD8055 programme, with improved pharmaceutical properties; evaluated in several solid-tumour indications.

nodes.label: CASTOR1
nodes.description: Cellular arginine sensor for mTORC1; binds arginine through tandem ACT domains and in the apo state sequesters GATOR2.

nodes.label: CASTOR2
nodes.description: CASTOR paralogue that heterodimerises with CASTOR1 and binds GATOR2 but does not itself bind arginine with high affinity.

nodes.label: GCN2
nodes.description: Kinase activated by uncharged tRNA on amino-acid deprivation; drives ATF4 translation and thereby SESN2 induction, providing a slower transcriptional arm of amino-acid sensing.

nodes.label: Leucyl-tRNA synthetase 1 (LARS1)
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic leucyl-tRNA synthetase proposed to act as a leucine-responsive RagD GAP; the assignment is contested because the yeast orthologue acts on the RagA/B counterpart with opposite polarity.

nodes.label: MAT2A (methionine adenosyltransferase 2A)
nodes.description: Enzyme converting methionine and ATP into S-adenosylmethionine; it generates the ligand actually sensed by SAMTOR, so methionine availability reaches mTORC1 only through MAT2A-produced SAM.

nodes.label: NPC1
nodes.description: Lysosomal cholesterol export protein that physically associates with SLC38A9; its loss traps cholesterol in the lumen and hyperactivates mTORC1.

nodes.label: O-GlcNAc transferase (OGT)
nodes.description: Sole enzyme adding O-linked GlcNAc from UDP-GlcNAc; the hexosamine pathway flux it reports is the proposed means by which glucose gates LARS1 function.

nodes.label: SAMTOR
nodes.description: S-adenosylmethionine sensor (Kd about 7 uM) that, unlike Sestrin2 and CASTOR1, acts directly on the GATOR1-KICSTOR assembly, linking dietary methionine to mTORC1.

nodes.label: SAR1B
nodes.description: COPII-associated small GTPase reported to bind leucine and regulate mTORC1; a single-laboratory finding awaiting independent replication.

nodes.label: Sestrin1
nodes.description: Sestrin family member that binds GATOR2 and is a p53 target; expressed in a tissue-restricted pattern that may determine which leucine-sensing mechanism dominates in a given tissue.

nodes.label: Sestrin2
nodes.description: Stress-inducible sestrin transcribed by p53 (DNA damage) and ATF4 (ER stress, amino-acid starvation via GCN2); apo-Sestrin2 sequesters GATOR2 to inhibit mTORC1 and was reported to activate AMPK; also a leucine sensor.

nodes.label: Sestrin3
nodes.description: Third Sestrin paralogue that also binds GATOR2; differential tissue expression across SESN1/2/3 underlies context-dependent leucine sensing.

nodes.label: SLC1A5 (ASCT2)
nodes.description: Plasma-membrane glutamine importer whose accumulated glutamine is the exchange substrate that drives LAT1-mediated leucine uptake.

nodes.label: SLC38A9
nodes.description: Lysosomal transceptor: reports luminal arginine through its N-terminal domain, exports leucine and other essential amino acids to the cytosol, and cooperates with NPC1 to couple lysosomal cholesterol to mTORC1.

nodes.label: SLC3A2 (CD98 heavy chain)
nodes.description: Heavy chain that disulphide-bonds to SLC7A5 to form the functional LAT1 transporter.

nodes.label: SLC7A5 (LAT1 light chain)
nodes.description: Bidirectional plasma-membrane antiporter that couples glutamine efflux to leucine influx, supplying the cytosolic leucine pool read by the sensors.

nodes.label: Lysosomal v-ATPase
nodes.description: Vacuolar H+-ATPase that acidifies the lysosome and undergoes amino-acid-dependent conformational change, relaying luminal amino-acid content outward to Ragulator - the inside-out sensing mechanism.

nodes.label: Androgen receptor
nodes.description: Nuclear receptor whose activation raises mTORC1 output and cyclin D translation in prostate cancer; reciprocal feedback with PI3K–AKT (PTEN loss).

nodes.label: EGFR
nodes.description: Epidermal growth factor receptor; activates PI3K mainly via GAB1 (and ERBB3 heterodimers) and Ras via GRB2–SOS; frequently amplified/mutated in cancer.

nodes.label: Estrogen receptor α
nodes.description: Nuclear receptor phosphorylated by S6K1 at Ser167, giving ligand-independent transcriptional activity.

nodes.label: IGF-1 receptor
nodes.description: Receptor tyrosine kinase for IGF-1. Reported to be tyrosine-phosphorylated and activated by the intrinsic tyrosine kinase activity of mTOR within mTORC2, constituting a feed-forward arm from mTORC2 back onto the receptor tier. NOTE: this node may already exist in the growth_factor_input module; the assembler should deduplicate rather than create a second copy.

nodes.label: Insulin receptor
nodes.description: α2β2 receptor tyrosine kinase; insulin binding triggers β-subunit autophosphorylation and IRS recruitment. Target of Grb10-mediated mTORC1 feedback.

nodes.label: IRS-1
nodes.description: Insulin receptor substrate 1; tyrosine-phosphorylated docking protein whose pYXXM motifs recruit p85–PI3K. Inhibitory serine phosphorylation by S6K1 is the classical mTORC1 negative-feedback arm.

nodes.label: Neurofibromin (NF1)
nodes.description: Ras GAP; its loss raises Ras·GTP and ERK/RSK input to TSC2. NF1 loss is a recurrent cancer lesion in this pathway.

nodes.label: Phosphatidic acid
nodes.description: Phospholipase D product that binds the FRB domain of mTOR in competition with FKBP12-rapamycin and promotes complex stability and signalling; a mechanical/nutrient-responsive lipid input.

nodes.label: Class I PI3K (p110α/p85)
nodes.description: Class IA phosphoinositide 3-kinase: p110α catalytic (PIK3CA) with p85 regulatory subunit; converts PIP2 to PIP3 on RTK/IRS/Ras input. PIK3CA hotspot mutations are frequent distal-network cancer lesions.

nodes.label: p85α (PIK3R1)
nodes.description: Regulatory subunit of class IA PI3K; stabilises p110, restrains its basal activity via nSH2/iSH2 contacts, and relieves that inhibition when its SH2 domains bind pYXXM motifs.

nodes.label: PI(4,5)P2
nodes.description: Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate; plasma-membrane substrate of class I PI3K and product of PTEN.

nodes.label: PI(3,4,5)P3
nodes.description: Phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate generated by PI3K; bound by the mSin1 PH domain, relieving its autoinhibition of mTORC2 and recruiting the complex to the plasma membrane.

nodes.label: Phospholipase D1
nodes.description: Phospholipase D isoform generating phosphatidic acid after mechanical stimulation of muscle; proposed mechanical input to mTORC1.

nodes.label: PTEN
nodes.description: PIP3 3-phosphatase and tumour suppressor; the main negative regulator of PI3K–AKT. Loss (prostate, GBM, endometrium) raises PIP3/AKT flux; it acts as a distal-network lesion.

nodes.label: Ras (K/H/N-Ras)
nodes.description: Small GTPase activated by RTK–GRB2–SOS; Ras·GTP recruits RAF (ERK cascade) and binds the p110α RBD; its pathway converges on TSC2 and Raptor to raise mTORC1 output.

nodes.label: Receptor tyrosine kinases (generic)
nodes.description: Growth-factor receptors (EGFR, ERBB2, PDGFR, MET, FGFR etc.) whose autophosphorylated tyrosines recruit PI3K (directly or via adaptors) and GRB2–SOS to Ras. Amplification converges on PI3K in cancer.

nodes.label: Aldolase A
nodes.description: Glycolytic aldolase acting as a glucose sensor: when not occupied by fructose-1,6-bisphosphate it signals through the lysosomal v-ATPase to assemble the AXIN-LKB1-AMPK module and suppress Ragulator-dependent mTORC1 activation.

nodes.label: ATP6AP1 (v-ATPase accessory subunit 1)
nodes.description: Accessory subunit of the lysosomal v-ATPase and the binding partner of PEN2 in the low-dose metformin route; the PEN2–ATP6AP1 interaction inhibits v-ATPase and triggers lysosomal AMPK activation without a fall in cellular ATP.

nodes.label: AXIN1
nodes.description: Scaffold that, under low energy or glucose, tethers LKB1 to AMPK (AXIN-AMPK-LKB1 complex) and to v-ATPase-Ragulator at the lysosome, while blocking Ragulator GEF activity toward RagA/B to switch mTORC1 off.

nodes.label: MO25-alpha (CAB39)
nodes.description: Armadillo-repeat scaffold that binds the C-terminus of STRADA and stabilises the LKB1-STRADA-MO25 heterotrimer, increasing LKB1 activity about 10-fold beyond STRADA alone.

nodes.label: CaMKK2 (CaMKK-beta)
nodes.description: Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent kinase kinase that phosphorylates AMPK Thr172 in response to rises in cytosolic Ca2+, independently of LKB1 and of the AMP:ATP ratio.

nodes.label: PHD2 (EGLN1)
nodes.description: Prolyl-4-hydroxylase domain protein 2, the principal cellular oxygen sensor. Uses O2 and 2-oxoglutarate to hydroxylate HIF-1α at Pro402/Pro564, creating the pVHL recognition site; hypoxia inactivates it, stabilising HIF-1α and inducing REDD1 and BNIP3.

nodes.label: PERK (EIF2AK3)
nodes.description: ER-resident eIF2alpha kinase activated by unfolded proteins (BiP release); phosphorylates eIF2alpha Ser51 to launch the integrated stress response and ATF4 translation.

nodes.label: LKB1-STRADA-MO25 complex
nodes.description: Heterotrimeric, constitutively active AMPK upstream kinase complex; AMP binding to AMPK gamma makes AMPK a better substrate rather than activating LKB1 itself. Also recruited to lysosomes by AXIN under glucose starvation.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial complex I (NADH dehydrogenase)
nodes.description: Entry point of the respiratory chain (approximately 45 subunits); its inhibition by metformin/phenformin or by hypoxia-limited respiration lowers ATP and raises AMP/ADP, activating AMPK.

nodes.label: PEN2 (PSENEN)
nodes.description: Gamma-secretase subunit identified as the direct low-dose metformin binding protein; metformin-bound PEN2 engages ATP6AP1 to inhibit v-ATPase, triggering AXIN-LKB1 recruitment and lysosomal AMPK activation.

nodes.label: PEX5 (peroxisomal import receptor)
nodes.description: Peroxisomal targeting-signal receptor reported to bind TSC1/TSC2 and localise a TSC complex pool to peroxisomes, where ROS activate TSC2 to repress mTORC1 and trigger autophagy.

nodes.label: LKB1 (STK11)
nodes.description: Constitutively active master upstream kinase that phosphorylates AMPK Thr172 (and 12 AMPK-related kinases); requires STRADA and MO25 for activity and cytoplasmic localisation. Tumour suppressor lost in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.

nodes.label: STRAD-alpha (STRADA)
nodes.description: Pseudokinase that binds the LKB1 kinase domain, induces its active conformation and retains LKB1 in the cytoplasm. Biallelic loss causes PMSE syndrome with impaired LKB1-AMPK signalling and neuronal mTORC1 hyperactivation.

nodes.label: glutaminase
nodes.description: Mitochondrial glutaminase catalysing the first step of glutaminolysis (glutamine to glutamate), upstream of glutamate dehydrogenase and of alpha-ketoglutarate-dependent Rag GTP loading.

nodes.label: NF1 loss-of-function
nodes.description: Loss of the Ras GAP neurofibromin, raising RAS-ERK-RSK flux onto the TSC complex; one of the lesions enrolled in the negative everolimus basket study.

nodes.label: PIK3CA activating mutation
nodes.description: Helical (E542K, E545K) and kinase (H1047R/L) hotspot gain-of-function mutations in ~30–40% of breast and 30% of endometrial cancers; distal-network lesion.

nodes.label: PTEN loss
nodes.description: Loss of the PIP3 phosphatase; roughly 30% of prostate, 40% of glioblastoma and 35% of endometrial cancers, and germline in PTEN hamartoma tumour syndrome.

nodes.label: Receptor tyrosine kinase amplification
nodes.description: Amplification of receptor tyrosine kinases converging on PI3K; distal-network lesion with low predicted mTORC1 dependency.

nodes.label: ABCB1 (P-glycoprotein)
nodes.description: ATP-binding cassette efflux transporter at the gut and blood-brain barrier; sirolimus and everolimus are substrates, which limits oral bioavailability and CNS exposure.

nodes.label: CYP3A4
nodes.description: Principal oxidative metabolising enzyme for sirolimus and everolimus; the basis of extensive drug-drug interaction potential and of therapeutic drug monitoring in transplantation.

nodes.label: FKBP12
nodes.description: 12 kDa peptidyl-prolyl isomerase immunophilin; its yeast orthologue FPR1 emerged from the original rapamycin-resistance screen. Binds rapamycin, and the binary complex then engages the mTOR FRB domain.

nodes.label: FKBP12-rapamycin complex
nodes.description: Binary complex of rapamycin with its intracellular receptor FKBP12; this composite surface, not either partner alone, is the species that binds the FRB domain of mTOR and inhibits mTORC1.

nodes.label: Cyclophilin A (PPIA)
nodes.description: The cyclosporine-cyclophilin A binary complex inhibits calcineurin; cyclophilin A has no role in rapalog action. Required to represent why cyclosporine causes post-transplant diabetes by a mechanism distinct from that of sirolimus.

nodes.label: Arf1
nodes.description: ADP-ribosylation factor 1, required for glutamine-induced activation of mTORC1 by a route that does not require the Rag GTPases.

nodes.label: C12orf66
nodes.description: KICSTOR subunit required for the integrity of the KICSTOR-GATOR1 assembly.

nodes.label: DEPDC5
nodes.description: Largest GATOR1 subunit; binds the Rag heterodimer through its SABA/SHEN domains and inhibits mTORC1 independently of catalysis. Loss-of-function variants cause familial focal epilepsy.

nodes.label: Folliculin (FLCN)
nodes.description: Tumour suppressor with a longin GAP domain; with FNIP1/2 provides the GAP activity for RagC/D. Mutated in Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome.

nodes.label: FLCN-FNIP complex
nodes.description: GTPase-activating complex for RagC/D; drives the heterodimer into the RagA/B.GTP-RagC/D.GDP state and is required in particular for mTORC1 phosphorylation of TFEB/TFE3.

nodes.label: FNIP1
nodes.description: Folliculin-interacting protein that heterodimerises with FLCN to form the active RagC/D GAP; also reported to bind AMPK.

nodes.label: FNIP2
nodes.description: Paralogue of FNIP1 that forms an equivalent FLCN-FNIP2 GAP complex.

nodes.label: GATOR1 (DEPDC5-NPRL2-NPRL3)
nodes.description: Trimeric GTPase-activating protein for RagA/B and therefore a negative regulator of mTORC1, active when amino acids are scarce; a tumour suppressor and the locus of familial focal epilepsies.

nodes.label: GATOR2
nodes.description: Octameric positive regulator of mTORC1 containing WDR24, WDR59, MIOS, SEH1L and SEC13; acts by inhibiting GATOR1 and is the common hub on which the Sestrin and CASTOR sensors converge.

nodes.label: ITFG2
nodes.description: KICSTOR subunit required for assembly of the scaffold that localises GATOR1 to the lysosome.

nodes.label: KICSTOR
nodes.description: Tetrameric scaffold (KPTN, ITFG2, C12orf66, SZT2) that recruits GATOR1 to the lysosomal surface and is required for nutrients to regulate mTORC1; non-redundant in humans.
aliases: KPTN, ITFG2, C12orf66 and SZT2-containing regulator of mTORC1

nodes.label: KPTN (kaptin)
nodes.description: KICSTOR subunit; biallelic loss causes a macrocephaly-intellectual disability syndrome consistent with mTORC1 disinhibition.

nodes.label: LAMTOR1 (p18)
nodes.description: Lipid-anchored Ragulator subunit whose N-terminal myristoylation and palmitoylation tether the entire complex to the lysosomal membrane; also contacts the v-ATPase.

nodes.label: LAMTOR2 (p14)
nodes.description: Roadblock-domain Ragulator subunit; forms a heterodimer with LAMTOR3 that contacts the Rag roadblock domains.

nodes.label: LAMTOR3 (MP1)
nodes.description: Roadblock-domain Ragulator subunit partnering LAMTOR2; originally characterised as a MEK1/ERK scaffold.

nodes.label: LAMTOR4 (C7orf59)
nodes.description: Roadblock-domain Ragulator subunit forming a heterodimer with LAMTOR5 that engages the Rag GTPase roadblock domains.

nodes.label: LAMTOR5 (HBXIP)
nodes.description: Roadblock-domain Ragulator subunit partnering LAMTOR4 within the pentameric complex.

nodes.label: MIOS
nodes.description: GATOR2 subunit (missing oocyte homologue) whose beta-propeller forms part of the binding surface for the amino-acid sensors Sestrin2 and CASTOR1.

nodes.label: NPRL2
nodes.description: GATOR1 subunit carrying the longin domain that supplies the catalytic arginine finger for GAP activity toward RagA/B.

nodes.label: NPRL3
nodes.description: GATOR1 subunit bridging NPRL2 and DEPDC5 and contributing to Rag binding; mutated in focal epilepsy.

nodes.label: Rab1A
nodes.description: Golgi-resident Rab GTPase reported to be required for amino-acid-dependent mTORC1 activation and to interact with Rheb; amplified in colorectal cancer.

nodes.label: Ragulator (LAMTOR1-5)
nodes.description: Lysosomal pentamer anchoring the Rag heterodimer and acting as RagA/B GEF; with v-ATPase it also docks AXIN-LKB1 for lysosomal AMPK activation under glucose starvation, serving as a catabolism/anabolism switch.

nodes.label: RNF152
nodes.description: Lysosome-associated RING-finger E3 ligase reported to K63-ubiquitinate Rheb, increasing its affinity for TSC2 and restraining Rheb–mTORC1 in the absence of growth factors.

nodes.label: RUVBL1 (Pontin)
nodes.description: AAA+ ATPase that, with RUVBL2, joins the TTT (Tel2-Tti1-Tti2) complex to form the TTT-RUVBL1/2 co-chaperone promoting mTORC1 dimerisation and lysosomal localisation.

nodes.label: RUVBL2 (Reptin)
nodes.description: AAA+ ATPase partner of RUVBL1 in the TTT-RUVBL1/2 module that chaperones newly synthesised PIKKs including mTOR.

nodes.label: SEC13
nodes.description: WD40 GATOR2 subunit also found in the COPII coat and the nuclear pore complex; a structural element of GATOR2.

nodes.label: SEH1L
nodes.description: WD40 GATOR2 subunit shared with the nuclear pore Nup107-160 complex; stabilises the GATOR2 assembly.

nodes.label: SH3BP4
nodes.description: SH3-domain binding protein that interacts with the inactive Rag heterodimer under amino-acid starvation and prevents formation of the active, mTORC1-recruiting state.

nodes.label: SKP2
nodes.description: SCF E3 ligase substrate-recognition subunit reported to K63-ubiquitinate RagA, promoting GATOR1 binding as a brake on amino-acid-driven mTORC1 hyperactivation.

nodes.label: SZT2
nodes.description: Very large KICSTOR subunit that binds GATOR1 directly and dictates GATOR control of mTORC1; biallelic mutation causes an infantile encephalopathy with epilepsy and dysmorphic corpus callosum.

nodes.label: FLCN loss-of-function
nodes.description: Germline loss-of-function variants in folliculin, abolishing RagC/D GAP activity and dysregulating mTORC1 in a tissue-dependent rather than uniformly increased manner.

nodes.label: SZT2 loss-of-function (biallelic)
nodes.description: Biallelic SZT2 loss-of-function variants that disable the KICSTOR scaffold; the clinical proof that this scaffold is non-redundant in humans.

nodes.label: WDR24
nodes.description: GATOR2 subunit with a beta-propeller and zinc-finger; required for GATOR2 to relieve GATOR1 inhibition and part of the sensor-binding surface.

nodes.label: WDR59
nodes.description: GATOR2 subunit with beta-propeller and RING-like domains; contributes to the GATOR2 scaffold that contacts GATOR1.

nodes.label: AKT (PKB)
nodes.description: Central PI3K effector held in check by mTORC1-driven feedback (S6K1-IRS-1, Grb10, S6K1-Rictor); relief of this feedback on mTORC1 inhibition produces the clinically important AKT rebound.

nodes.label: AKT3
nodes.description: Brain-enriched AKT isoform; somatic mosaic activating AKT3 variants confined to malformed cortex cause hemimegalencephaly and focal cortical dysplasia type II.

nodes.label: CK1alpha
nodes.description: Priming kinase that phosphorylates mTOR-primed DEPTOR to create the βTrCP degron; the missing step between mTORC1 phosphorylation of DEPTOR and its βTrCP-dependent destruction.

nodes.label: DGKζ (diacylglycerol kinase ζ)
nodes.description: Diacylglycerol kinase whose PLD-independent production of phosphatidic acid is required for mechanical-load activation of mTORC1 in skeletal muscle.

nodes.label: ERK1/2
nodes.description: Photic signal transducer in SCN neurons; the MEK–ERK arm that couples light to mTORC1 activity (S6K1 and 4E-BP1 phosphorylation) in the central clock. Shared node — likely already defined in growth_factor_input.

nodes.label: Farnesyltransferase
nodes.description: Prenylates the Rheb CAAX motif (Cys181); farnesylation is required for Rheb membrane localisation and mTORC1 activation.

nodes.label: GRB2
nodes.description: SH2–SH3 adaptor that binds phosphotyrosines on activated receptor tyrosine kinases (directly on EGFR; via SHC or IRS-1 for the insulin and IGF-1 receptors) and brings the Ras GEF SOS1 to the membrane.

nodes.label: GSK3β
nodes.description: Constitutively active kinase inhibited by AKT at Ser9; one of the AKT substrates that remains substantially phosphorylated when AKT carries Thr308 alone. Also phosphorylates Rictor, feeding back onto mTORC2.

nodes.label: HERC1
nodes.description: HECT/RLD-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase reported to bind and ubiquitinate TSC2 when TSC2 is not protected by TSC1.

nodes.label: IKKβ
nodes.description: Inhibitor of NF-kB kinase beta; downstream of TNF it phosphorylates TSC1 Ser487/Ser511, suppressing TSC1 and activating mTORC1 and VEGF-driven angiogenesis.

nodes.label: p38α MAPK
nodes.description: Stress-activated MAPK; one of the two upstream activators of MNK1 and therefore of eIF4E Ser209 phosphorylation.

nodes.label: MK2
nodes.description: Kinase whose translation is controlled by mTOR; MK2 stabilises SASP transcripts via ZFP36L1, the second documented translational route from mTORC1 to the SASP.

nodes.label: MEK1/2
nodes.description: Dual-specificity MAP2Ks that phosphorylate ERK1/2 on the TEY motif.

nodes.label: PDK1
nodes.description: 3-Phosphoinositide-dependent kinase 1; constitutively active PH-domain kinase that phosphorylates the activation loop of AKT (Thr308), RSK (NTKD) and S6K1 once PIP3 brings substrate and kinase together.

nodes.label: PHLPP1/2
nodes.description: PH-domain leucine-rich repeat protein phosphatases that dephosphorylate AKT Ser473 (hydrophobic motif), terminating mTORC2-dependent AKT activation.

nodes.label: PP2A (B55α holoenzyme)
nodes.description: Protein phosphatase 2A; the B55α-containing holoenzyme dephosphorylates AKT Thr308, opposing PDK1.

nodes.label: DNA-PKcs
nodes.description: DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit; alternative, mTORC2-independent AKT Ser473 kinase after DNA double-strand breaks.

nodes.label: RAF kinases
nodes.description: Ras-effector MAP3Ks that phosphorylate and activate MEK1/2.

nodes.label: p90 RSK
nodes.description: p90 ribosomal S6 kinase downstream of ERK; phosphorylates Raptor at an activating cluster and contributes to DEPTOR phosphodegron formation, linking RAS-pathway activation to mTORC1 output.

nodes.label: SOS1 (Son of sevenless 1)
nodes.description: Ras guanine-nucleotide exchange factor held by GRB2 and relocated to activated receptors, where it loads Ras with GTP.

nodes.label: TBC1D7
nodes.description: Third subunit of the TSC complex (1 copy per 2:2 TSC1–TSC2); bridges TSC1 coiled-coils and stabilises TSC1–TSC2 association.

nodes.label: TCTP
nodes.description: Translationally controlled tumour protein; proposed Rheb GEF in Drosophila, not supported by later biochemical work (contested).

nodes.label: TSC1 (hamartin)
nodes.description: Scaffold subunit of the TSC complex stabilising TSC2; phosphorylated at Ser487/Ser511 by IKK-beta, which suppresses the complex and raises mTORC1 under TNF/inflammatory signalling.

nodes.label: TSC2 (tuberin)
nodes.description: GAP subunit of the TSC1-TSC2-TBC1D7 complex acting on Rheb. Activated by AMPK (Ser1387/Ser1345) and GSK3 phosphorylation, released from 14-3-3 by REDD1, inhibited by AKT/ERK/RSK phosphorylation; a p53 transcriptional target.

nodes.label: TSC complex (TSC1–TSC2–TBC1D7)
nodes.description: Rheb GAP complex; recruited to the lysosomal surface in a Rag-dependent manner on amino-acid withdrawal, providing a second arm of amino-acid control over mTORC1 that acts on Rheb rather than on recruitment.

nodes.label: AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase)
nodes.description: Second catalytic α-subunit isoform of AMPK, carrying the activation-loop Thr172. Predominant α-isoform in skeletal muscle, heart and liver and the isoform most relevant to exercise, metformin and the inhibitory mTORC1 phosphorylation at Ser345.

nodes.label: ATM kinase
nodes.description: PIKK-family DNA-damage sensor kinase (activated by MRN at double-strand breaks and, independently, by direct oxidation under ROS); phosphorylates p53 Ser15 and signals via LKB1-AMPK-TSC2 to repress mTORC1.

nodes.label: BNIP3
nodes.description: HIF-1-induced BH3-only mitochondrial protein mediating hypoxic mitophagy; reported to bind Rheb and reduce its GTP loading, inhibiting mTORC1 independently of TSC2.

nodes.label: REDD1 (DDIT4)
nodes.description: Stress-induced inhibitor of mTORC1 acting through the TSC complex; its transcript is rhythmically expressed in mouse peripheral tissues, offering a candidate clock-to-mTORC1 transcriptional route.

nodes.label: eIF2alpha (EIF2S1)
nodes.description: Alpha subunit of eIF2; Ser51 phosphorylation by PERK/GCN2/PKR/HRI lowers ternary-complex availability, repressing global initiation while selectively increasing ATF4 translation.

nodes.label: PP2Cα (PPM1A)
nodes.description: Mg2+/Mn2+-dependent protein phosphatase 2C family member that dephosphorylates AMPK Thr172 and terminates AMPK signalling; AMP binding to the γ-subunit protects Thr172 from this dephosphorylation, which is a major component of allosteric AMPK activation.

nodes.label: AMPK beta1 (scaffold subunit)
nodes.description: Beta subunit of AMPK: myristoylated scaffold bridging alpha and gamma, carries the carbohydrate-binding module (glycogen sensing) and forms the ADaM drug-binding site with the alpha kinase domain. beta2 (PRKAB2) is the muscle paralogue.

nodes.label: AMPK gamma1 (nucleotide-sensing subunit)
nodes.description: Gamma subunit of AMPK with four CBS motifs binding AMP, ADP or ATP competitively at sites 1 and 3; occupancy by AMP/ADP drives allosteric activation and protects pThr172 from phosphatases. gamma2/gamma3 paralogues exist.

nodes.label: p53
nodes.description: Stress-activated transcription factor; after DNA damage or AMPK phosphorylation (Ser15) induces SESN1/2, DDIT4, PTEN, TSC2 and AMPK beta1, forming a coordinated brake on IGF-1/AKT/mTORC1 signalling.

nodes.label: pVHL (VHL)
nodes.description: Substrate-recognition component of the CUL2–elongin BC E3 ubiquitin ligase that binds prolyl-hydroxylated HIF-1α and targets it for proteasomal degradation in normoxia.

nodes.label: Cdc37
nodes.description: Kinase-specific Hsp90 co-chaperone that delivers client protein kinases, including PIKK-family members, to the Hsp90 cycle.

nodes.label: Hsp90
nodes.description: ATP-dependent chaperone that, with the TTT/R2TP machinery and the kinase-specific co-chaperone Cdc37, matures newly synthesised mTOR; Hsp90 inhibition destabilises mTOR and reduces mTORC1 signalling.

nodes.label: Tel2
nodes.description: Core subunit of the TTT (Tel2-Tti1-Tti2) co-chaperone module that binds nascent PIKKs including mTOR and, with R2TP/Hsp90, governs their folding, stability and assembly into complexes.

nodes.label: Tti1
nodes.description: Tel2-interacting protein 1; with Tel2 and Tti2 forms the TTT module required for mTOR protein stability and for assembly of both mTORC1 and mTORC2.

nodes.label: Tti2
nodes.description: Third TTT subunit; biallelic TTI2 variants cause intellectual disability, consistent with a non-redundant role in PIKK stability in humans.

nodes.label: TTT complex (Tel2-Tti1-Tti2)
nodes.description: Trimeric PIKK-dedicated co-chaperone that works with R2TP/Hsp90 to fold newly synthesised mTOR and promote its incorporation into mTORC1 and mTORC2.

nodes.label: VPS34
nodes.description: Class III PI3-kinase proposed as an amino-acid-responsive activator of mTORC1 in parallel with the Rag route; the assignment conflicts with its established pro-autophagic role and is contested.

nodes.label: PER2 (Period 2)
nodes.description: Negative-limb clock protein. Beyond transcriptional repression of CLOCK–BMAL1, PER2 binds TSC1 and recruits it to the mTORC1 complex, suppressing mTORC1 in a time-of-day-dependent manner.

nodes.label: AKT1 activating mutation
nodes.description: PH-domain E17K substitution causing constitutive membrane localisation and activation of AKT1 (breast, colorectal, ovarian cancers); distal-network lesion.

nodes.label: AKT3 activating mutation
nodes.description: Somatic mosaic gain-of-function AKT3 variants confined to malformed cortex cause hemimegalencephaly and focal cortical dysplasia type II.

nodes.label: NF2 loss of function
nodes.description: Loss-of-function NF2 (merlin) variant; co-occurred with the TSC1 lesion in the index everolimus exceptional responder and was one of the five selection genes in the negative prospective basket study.

nodes.label: Lysosome
nodes.description: Organelle whose cytosolic surface is the platform for mTORC1 activation and whose lumen is the compartment sampled by the inside-out amino-acid sensing machinery; its dysfunction is an upstream cause of mTOR dysregulation.

nodes.label: Rag GTPase heterodimer (RagA/B-RagC/D)
nodes.description: Obligate heterodimer recruiting mTORC1 to the lysosome; relays glucose as well as amino-acid sufficiency to mTORC1 largely independently of AMPK, and mediates AMPK-independent mTORC1 inhibition by metformin.

nodes.label: RagA
nodes.description: Rag GTPase that, loaded with GTP, confers Raptor binding on the heterodimer. Target of GATOR1 GAP activity and of Ragulator/SLC38A9 GEF activity.

nodes.label: RagB
nodes.description: Paralogue of RagA with equivalent function; GTP-loaded RagB binds Raptor and is the substrate of GATOR1 GAP activity.

nodes.label: RagC
nodes.description: Rag GTPase that must be GDP-loaded for the active heterodimer configuration; substrate of the FLCN-FNIP GAP and determinant of substrate-specific mTORC1 signalling to TFEB.

nodes.label: RagD
nodes.description: Paralogue of RagC; GDP-loaded RagD supports the active heterodimer. Proposed substrate of LARS1 GAP activity in the contested leucine-sensing model.

nodes.label: FKBP38 (FKBP8)
nodes.description: Proposed endogenous mTORC1 inhibitor displaced by Rheb·GTP; the model is contested because independent laboratories did not reproduce it.

nodes.label: Rheb
nodes.description: Small GTPase resident on lysosomal/endomembrane surfaces; GTP-loaded Rheb binds the mTOR kinase domain and allosterically activates it, making lysosomal co-localisation the point of pathway convergence.

nodes.label: PRAS40
nodes.description: Substoichiometric mTORC1 inhibitor carrying its own TOS motif; competes with substrates for the Raptor recognition surface. AKT phosphorylation at Thr246 releases it, giving feed-forward derepression by growth factors.

nodes.label: Cullin-1
nodes.description: Scaffold subunit of the SCF E3 ubiquitin ligase that degrades DEPTOR.

nodes.label: DEPTOR
nodes.description: Tandem DEP-domain plus PDZ-domain inhibitory subunit of both mTORC1 and mTORC2; binds the mTOR FAT region. Phosphorylated by active mTOR and by S6K1/RSK/CK1alpha, then degraded via SCF-betaTrCP, so active mTOR removes its own brake.

nodes.label: beta-TrCP2 (FBXW11)
nodes.description: Second beta-TrCP paralogue; redundant with BTRC as the substrate-recognition subunit for the DEPTOR phosphodegron.

nodes.label: SCF(beta-TrCP) E3 ubiquitin ligase
nodes.description: Cullin-RING ligase (SKP1-CUL1-RBX1 with the F-box receptor beta-TrCP1/2) that recognises the phosphodegron of DEPTOR and targets it for proteasomal destruction, creating a positive-feedback loop on mTOR activity.

nodes.label: SKP1
nodes.description: Adaptor linking CUL1 to the F-box protein beta-TrCP in the SCF ligase acting on DEPTOR.

nodes.label: Mitochondria-associated ER membranes
nodes.description: ER–mitochondria contact sites hosting a distinct pool of mTORC2–AKT signalling that controls MAM integrity, calcium transfer and mitochondrial physiology.

nodes.label: Plasma membrane
nodes.description: Site at which PIP3 is generated and to which PIP3 recruits both mTORC2 (via the mSin1 PH domain) and its membrane-targeted substrate AKT.

nodes.label: mTOR kinase ATP cleft
nodes.description: Nucleotide-binding cleft of the bilobed mTOR kinase domain

nodes.label: mSin1 CRIM domain
nodes.description: Conserved-region-in-the-middle domain of mSin1; its acidic loop engages the basic surface of the AGC-kinase N-lobe and is the principal distal docking site (~75 A from the catalytic cleft) for Akt, SGK1 and PKC.

nodes.label: ETV7
nodes.description: ETS-family transcription factor reported as the defining subunit of a putative third, rapamycin-insensitive mTOR assembly (mTORC3) in cancer cells. Described by a single laboratory and not widely replicated, so the evidence remains weak.

nodes.label: mTOR FATC domain
nodes.description: Extreme C-terminal FATC domain; packs against the kinase domain and is indispensable for catalytic activity - deletion of even a single residue abolishes mTOR kinase function.

nodes.label: mTOR FAT domain
nodes.description: FRAP-ATM-TRRAP domain, the alpha-helical clamp that wraps the kinase domain and holds it in a partially inactive conformation; the FAT-kinase interface is the target of activating cancer mutations and of Rheb-induced conformational change.

nodes.label: FRB domain of mTOR
nodes.description: ~100-residue four-helix bundle between the FAT and kinase domains of mTOR forming the binding site for the FKBP12-rapamycin binary complex; solvent-exposed in mTORC1 and occluded by Rictor-mSin1 in mTORC2.

nodes.label: mTOR N-HEAT/M-HEAT solenoid
nodes.description: N-terminal alpha-solenoid of mTOR (horn and bridge), ~20 HEAT repeats; forms the mTORC1/mTORC2 dimer interface, the Raptor- and Rictor-binding surface and, together with the FAT domain, the Rheb-binding site.

nodes.label: mTOR kinase domain (PIKK)
nodes.description: PI3K-like catalytic domain of mTOR with a deeply recessed active-site cleft walled by the FRB domain, the LBE (mLST8-binding element) and the activation loop; the catalytic unit of both complexes.

nodes.label: mSin1
nodes.description: 522-residue mTORC2 subunit with four regions: N-terminal Rictor-binding segment, central CRIM domain that docks AGC substrates, a Ras-binding domain, and a C-terminal PH domain that binds PIP3 and autoinhibits the complex.

nodes.label: mLST8 (GbetaL)
nodes.description: WD40 beta-propeller shared by both complexes; contacts the mTOR kinase domain near the activation loop and stabilises the catalytic conformation.

nodes.label: mTOR
nodes.description: 2549-residue ~289 kDa PIKK-family Ser/Thr kinase (1p36.22). N-HEAT/M-HEAT solenoid, FAT domain, FRB, bilobed kinase domain, C-terminal FATC required for catalysis; deep substrate cleft partially occluded by an inhibitory element.

nodes.label: mTORC1
nodes.description: Rapamycin-sensitive mTOR complex 1 (mTOR, Raptor, mLST8, PRAS40, DEPTOR); the convergence point of energy, oxygen and stress inputs via TSC-Rheb, Raptor phosphorylation and Rag GTPases; phosphorylates ULK1 Ser757 and AMPK alpha2 Ser345.

nodes.label: mTORC2
nodes.description: ~1.0 MDa homodimer of mTOR, mLST8, Rictor and mSin1 with substoichiometric Protor-1/2 and DEPTOR; FRB occluded by Rictor-mSin1, hence acutely rapamycin-insensitive. Phosphorylates AGC kinases via distal docking.
nodes.gene: MTOR, RICTOR, MLST8, MAPKAP1, PRR5, PRR5L, DEPTOR

nodes.label: mTORC3 (putative)
nodes.description: Putative third mTOR assembly containing ETV7, reported to be rapamycin-insensitive and to drive proliferation in cancer cells. Single-laboratory description, not widely replicated, so the evidence remains weak.

nodes.label: mSin1 PH domain
nodes.description: C-terminal pleckstrin-homology domain of mSin1; in the basal state it folds back onto the mTOR kinase domain and suppresses catalysis, and binding of PtdIns(3,4,5)P3 releases this autoinhibition at the plasma membrane.

nodes.label: Protor-1
nodes.description: Accessory mTORC2 subunit binding Rictor; dispensable for complex assembly but implicated in efficient mTORC2-dependent SGK1 activation, notably in kidney.

nodes.label: Protor-2
nodes.description: Accessory Rictor-binding mTORC2 subunit, paralogue of Protor-1; its degradation has been linked to enhanced mTORC2-dependent PKCδ phosphorylation and cell migration.

nodes.label: RAIP motif
nodes.description: N-terminal sequence of 4E-BP1 that binds Raptor and cooperates with the C-terminal TOS motif in substrate recruitment.

nodes.label: mSin1 Ras-binding domain
nodes.description: Ras-binding domain of mSin1, which engages Ras-family GTPases and couples Ras signalling to mTORC2; its functional contribution remains incompletely resolved.

nodes.label: Rictor
nodes.description: Defining, rapamycin-insensitive subunit of mTORC2; binds mSin1 through its N-terminal region, contributes to steric occlusion of the FRB domain, and forms part of the N-terminal mooring that engages the Akt kinase C-lobe.

nodes.label: Raptor
nodes.description: 1335-residue defining subunit of mTORC1: N-terminal caspase-like domain (non-proteolytic), HEAT-like central region, C-terminal WD40 beta-propeller. Wraps the mTOR N-HEAT solenoid and presents the outward-facing TOS-motif substrate surface.

nodes.label: TOS motif (TOR signalling motif)
nodes.description: Five-residue F [DE] [IML] [DE] [LI] motif (S6K1 FDIDL, 4E-BP1 FEMDI, PRAS40 FVMDE, HIF-1alpha) that docks substrates and PRAS40 onto Raptor and so onto mTORC1; mutation of the motif abolishes mTORC1-dependent phosphorylation.

nodes.label: TRPML1
nodes.description: Lysosomal cation channel releasing local Ca2+ on mTORC1 inhibition or lysosomal stress, activating calcineurin; itself a CLEAR-network target gene, forming a feed-forward loop with TFEB.

nodes.label: mSin1 isoform 5 (mSin1.5, PH-domain-less)
nodes.description: Splice isoform of mSin1 lacking the C-terminal PH domain; assembles an mTORC2 species whose AKT Ser473 kinase activity is not gated by insulin/PIP3 (Frias et al. 2006).

nodes.label: MTOR FAT-domain hotspot variants
nodes.description: Activating MTOR substitutions in the FAT domain, including A1459P, C1483Y and E1799K; effects on substrate phosphorylation and inhibitor binding vary by variant.

nodes.label: MTOR kinase-domain hotspot variants
nodes.description: Activating substitutions in the MTOR kinase domain, including S2215Y and E2419K. FRB resistance substitutions such as F2108L are a distinct class.

nodes.label: betaTrCP
nodes.description: F-box substrate-recognition subunit of the SCF E3 ubiquitin ligase; binds phosphodegron-bearing DEPTOR and directs its polyubiquitination and proteasomal destruction.

nodes.label: 4E-BP1
nodes.description: Translational repressor of eIF4E, phosphorylated hierarchically by mTORC1 (Thr37/Thr46 first, then Thr70 and Ser65). Thr37/Thr46 are the rapamycin-resistant sites that define the limits of rapalog pharmacology.

nodes.label: 4E-BP2
nodes.description: 4E-BP paralogue predominant in brain; mTORC1 substrate sharing 4E-BP1 phosphosites; its loss enhances LTP yet produces autism-like behaviour via excess eIF4E-dependent translation.

nodes.label: LARP1
nodes.description: La-related protein 1; DM15 domain binds the m7G cap and adjacent 5'TOP motif when mTORC1 is inactive, excluding eIF4F; mTORC1 phosphorylation releases TOP mRNAs. Also binds Raptor and PABP and stabilises TOP mRNAs.

nodes.label: MAF1
nodes.description: Conserved RNA polymerase III repressor; mTORC1 phosphorylation at Ser60, Ser68 and Ser75 inactivates it, derepressing tRNA and 5S rRNA transcription.

nodes.label: PP2A
nodes.description: Protein phosphatase 2A catalytic subunit; associates with S6K1 and dephosphorylates S6K1 Thr389 and TIF-IA Ser199 when mTORC1 is inhibited by rapamycin.

nodes.label: S6K1 (p70 S6 kinase 1)
nodes.description: AGC kinase activated by mTORC1 (Thr389) and PDK1 (Thr229); phosphorylates rpS6, eIF4B, PDCD4, SKAR, eEF2K, UBF, CBP80, mTOR Ser2448 and IRS-1. Controls cell size; fully rapamycin-sensitive.

nodes.label: S6K2 (p70 S6 kinase 2)
nodes.description: S6K1 paralogue activated by mTORC1 at Thr388; predominantly nuclear; principal rpS6 kinase in S6K1-null cells; S6K1/S6K2 double knockout is perinatally lethal.

nodes.label: TIF-IA (RRN3)
nodes.description: Pol I transcription initiation factor bridging initiation-competent Pol I to SL1; mTOR-dependent Ser44 phosphorylation and rapamycin-induced Ser199 dephosphorylation control its activity and nucleolar localisation.

nodes.label: UBF
nodes.description: Upstream binding factor; HMG-box nucleolar transcription factor binding rDNA, recruiting SL1 and Pol I; its C-terminal activation domain is phosphorylated in an mTOR/S6K1-dependent manner.

nodes.label: AMBRA1
nodes.description: Beclin-1-interacting autophagy activator and scaffold for TRAF6-mediated ULK1 ubiquitylation; mTORC1 phosphorylation holds it inactive, coupling nutrient status to ULK1 stability.

nodes.label: ATG101
nodes.description: HORMA-domain subunit of the ULK1 initiation complex that stabilises ATG13 and is required for autophagy initiation.

nodes.label: ATG13
nodes.description: Adaptor subunit of the ULK1 initiation complex, bridging ULK1 and FIP200; phosphorylated by mTORC1 as part of layered repression of phagophore initiation.

nodes.label: ATG14L
nodes.description: Autophagy-specific targeting subunit of the class III PI3K complex I; phosphorylated by mTORC1 (inhibitory) and by ULK1 at Ser29 (activating), setting VPS34 lipid-kinase activity at the phagophore.

nodes.label: p300
nodes.description: Acetyltransferase that acetylates ATG proteins to suppress autophagy and acetylates lipogenic regulators; phosphorylated by mTORC1, coupling nutrient status to acetylation-dependent autophagy and lipid output.

nodes.label: Grb10
nodes.description: Adaptor stabilised by mTORC1 phosphorylation that inhibits insulin and IGF-1 receptor signalling; a second feedback brake lost when mTORC1 is pharmacologically inhibited.

nodes.label: Lipin1
nodes.description: Phosphatidate phosphatase and nuclear SREBP antagonist; mTORC1 phosphorylation retains it in the cytoplasm, which is how mTORC1 controls nuclear SREBP activity.

nodes.label: calcineurin
nodes.description: Calcium- and calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase; the target of the FKBP12-FK506 and cyclophilin-cyclosporine complexes, and not a target of the FKBP12-rapamycin complex.

nodes.label: FIP200
nodes.description: Scaffold subunit of the ULK1 initiation complex, required for phagophore nucleation and for ULK1 kinase activity and stability.

nodes.label: Pacer
nodes.description: Rubicon-like autophagy enhancer that promotes autophagosome-lysosome fusion by engaging HOPS and STX17; reported mTORC1 substrate linking nutrient status to maturation.

nodes.label: STAT3
nodes.description: Transcription factor whose Ser727 transactivation-domain phosphorylation is rapamycin-sensitive and mTOR-dependent, linking mTORC1 to inflammatory and metabolic transcription.
aliases: signal transducer and activator of transcription 3

nodes.label: TFE3
nodes.description: MiT/TFE-family paralogue of TFEB, phosphorylated by mTORC1 at equivalent sites (Ser321) and similarly retained in the cytoplasm by 14-3-3.

nodes.label: TFEB
nodes.description: Master transcription factor of the autophagy–lysosome (CLEAR) programme, inhibited by mTORC1-dependent phosphorylation and cytoplasmic retention; reported to feed back onto peripheral clock gene expression.

nodes.label: ULK1
nodes.description: Autophagy-initiating kinase (ULK1-ATG13-FIP200-ATG101). Activated by AMPK phosphorylation (Ser317/Ser555/Ser777) and inhibited by mTORC1 Ser757 phosphorylation, which disrupts ULK1-AMPK binding; feeds back on AMPK.

nodes.label: UVRAG
nodes.description: Beclin-1 partner in class III PI3K complex II that promotes autophagosome and endosome maturation; mTORC1 phosphorylation at Ser498 restrains this maturation step.

nodes.label: WIPI2
nodes.description: PI(3)P effector that recruits the ATG12-ATG5-ATG16L1 conjugation machinery to the phagophore; mTORC1 phosphorylation promotes its ubiquitin-dependent degradation.

nodes.label: XPLN (ARHGEF3)
nodes.description: Rho-family guanine nucleotide exchange factor reported as an endogenous mTORC2 inhibitor that binds Rictor and suppresses AKT Ser473 phosphorylation, GEF-independently. HGNC symbol not asserted here.
aliases: exchange factor found in platelets, leukocytic and neuronal tissue

nodes.label: Protein kinase C (generic)
nodes.description: PKC family; mTORC2 supports maturation of selected isoforms through turn-motif/TOR-interaction-motif priming. Hydrophobic-motif phosphorylation can occur by PKC autophosphorylation.

nodes.label: PKCα
nodes.description: Conventional PKC isoform phosphorylated cotranslationally by ribosome-associated mTORC2 at turn and hydrophobic motifs, a requirement for its folding and stability.

nodes.label: PKCβII
nodes.description: Conventional PKC isoform whose turn motif (Thr641) and hydrophobic motif (Ser660) are mTORC2-dependent priming sites required for a stable, signalling-competent enzyme.

nodes.label: PKCδ
nodes.description: Novel PKC isoform whose turn- and hydrophobic-motif phosphorylation by mTORC2 supports its stability and its contribution to migration signalling.

nodes.label: PKCε
nodes.description: Novel PKC isoform among the mTORC2-primed PKCs; priming-site phosphorylation is required for maturation and stability.

nodes.label: PKCζ
nodes.description: Atypical PKC; mTORC2-dependent turn-motif phosphorylation supports its stability, and as part of the Par3–Par6–aPKC module it establishes epithelial apicobasal polarity.

nodes.label: SGK1
nodes.description: Serum- and glucocorticoid-induced kinase 1; mTORC2 substrate at hydrophobic-motif Ser422, governing distal nephron ion transport through ENaC, Na+/K+-ATPase and CLC-K, and phosphorylating NDRG1.

nodes.label: Ribosome
nodes.description: Translating ribosome; a minor subset of mTORC2 associates with it, which both activates mTORC2 in a growth-factor-responsive manner and permits cotranslational turn-motif phosphorylation of nascent AGC kinases.

nodes.label: Brf1 (TFIIIB)
nodes.description: TFIIIB subunit required to recruit Pol III to tRNA and 5S promoters; direct binding target of MAF1-mediated repression.

nodes.label: Cyclin D1
nodes.description: G1 cyclin encoded by a structured-5'UTR mRNA whose translation is eIF4E/4E-BP-dependent; a key oncogenic output of mTORC1.

nodes.label: eEF2
nodes.description: GTPase catalysing ribosomal translocation during elongation; Thr56 phosphorylation by eEF2K prevents ribosome binding and halts elongation.

nodes.label: eEF2 kinase
nodes.description: Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent alpha-kinase that phosphorylates eEF2 Thr56 to slow elongation; inhibited by S6K1/RSK phosphorylation at Ser366 and by mTOR-dependent Ser78 phosphorylation.

nodes.label: eIF3 complex
nodes.description: Multisubunit 43S preinitiation-complex factor that scaffolds inactive S6K1 and recruits mTORC1 upon stimulation; bridged to eIF4F through eIF4G and bound by phospho-eIF4B.

nodes.label: eIF4A1
nodes.description: DEAD-box RNA helicase of eIF4F that unwinds structured 5'UTRs; stimulated by eIF4B and inhibited by PDCD4.

nodes.label: eIF4B
nodes.description: RNA-binding cofactor that stimulates eIF4A helicase activity; S6K1/RSK phosphorylation at Ser422 enhances its recruitment to eIF3/preinitiation complexes and translation of structured 5'UTRs such as c-Myc.

nodes.label: eIF4E
nodes.description: Cap-binding subunit of eIF4F and rate-limiting factor for cap-dependent translation; the point at which BMAL1-dependent and 4E-BP1-dependent circadian translational control converge.

nodes.label: eIF4F complex
nodes.description: Cap-binding initiation complex (eIF4E, eIF4G, eIF4A) whose assembly is gated by 4E-BP phosphorylation; drives selective translation of cyclin D1, c-Myc, VEGF, HIF-1alpha and Mcl-1 mRNAs.

nodes.label: eIF4G1
nodes.description: Scaffold of eIF4F binding eIF4E (via the YxxxxLPhi motif shared with 4E-BPs), eIF4A, eIF3, PABP and MNK; carries rapamycin-sensitive C-terminal phosphosites.

nodes.label: Exon junction complex
nodes.description: Protein complex deposited upstream of exon-exon junctions during splicing; SKAR-dependent recruitment of S6K1 couples splicing to enhanced translation of spliced mRNAs.

nodes.label: TFIIIC
nodes.description: Pol III promoter-recognition factor for tRNA and 5S genes; reported to associate with mTOR, which is found at tRNA and 5S rRNA genes.

nodes.label: HIF-1alpha
nodes.description: Oxygen-labile transcription factor stabilised under hypoxia (loss of PHD/VHL-dependent degradation). Upstream of mTORC1 it induces REDD1 (DDIT4) and BNIP3; downstream it is an mTORC1 translational target (feedback).

nodes.label: Mcl-1
nodes.description: Anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family protein whose translation is 4E-BP/eIF4E-dependent; mediates mTORC1-dependent survival.

nodes.label: MNK1/2
nodes.description: MAP kinase-interacting kinases activated by ERK/p38; dock on eIF4G to phosphorylate eIF4E Ser209, an mTORC1-independent modulation of eIF4E oncogenic activity.

nodes.label: c-Myc
nodes.description: Transcription factor with structured-5'UTR mRNA translated in an eIF4F/eIF4B-dependent manner downstream of mTORC1; master transcriptional driver of ribosome biogenesis genes.

nodes.label: CBP80 (NCBP1)
nodes.description: 80 kDa subunit of the nuclear cap-binding complex bound to mRNAs during the pioneer round of translation; reported S6K1 substrate and S6K1/SKAR-associated factor on spliced mRNAs.

nodes.label: PABP
nodes.description: Cytoplasmic poly(A)-binding protein 1; binds LARP1 and eIF4G, linking the 3' poly(A) tail to cap-dependent initiation and TOP mRNA stability.

nodes.label: PDCD4
nodes.description: Programmed cell death 4; tumour suppressor whose MA3 domains bind eIF4A and block helicase activity; S6K1 phosphorylation at Ser67 creates a betaTrCP degron, triggering proteasomal degradation.

nodes.label: RNA polymerase I
nodes.description: Nucleolar polymerase transcribing the 47S pre-rRNA; recruited to rDNA by UBF/SL1 and TIF-IA under mTORC1 control.

nodes.label: RNA polymerase III
nodes.description: Polymerase transcribing tRNA and 5S rRNA genes; recruited by TFIIIB/TFIIIC and repressed by dephosphorylated MAF1.

nodes.label: 47S pre-rRNA
nodes.description: Pol I primary transcript processed into 18S, 5.8S and 28S rRNAs; its synthesis is the rate-limiting, mTORC1-scaled step of ribosome biogenesis.

nodes.label: Ribosomal protein S6
nodes.description: 40S ribosomal protein phosphorylated by S6K1/2 at Ser235/236/240/244 (and by RSK at Ser235/236). Phosphorylation determines cell size and glucose homeostasis; its classical role in TOP mRNA translation is no longer accepted.

nodes.label: 5S rRNA
nodes.description: Pol III-transcribed ribosomal RNA incorporated into the 60S subunit; transcription repressed by MAF1 and derepressed by mTORC1.

nodes.label: SKAR (POLDIP3)
nodes.description: S6K1 Aly/REF-like target; exon-junction-complex component phosphorylated by S6K1 (Ser383/Ser385) that recruits active S6K1 to newly spliced mRNAs to enhance pioneer-round translation.

nodes.label: SL1/TIF-IB (TBP–TAF1A/TAF1B/TAF1C)
nodes.description: Promoter selectivity factor of RNA polymerase I: a TBP-containing complex (TAF1A/TAF1B/TAF1C) that, together with UBF, nucleates the pre-initiation complex at the rDNA promoter. RRN3/TIF-IA bridges initiation-competent Pol I to promoter-bound SL1, which is the step at which the mTORC1–TIF-IA input is transduced into 47S pre-rRNA synthesis.

nodes.label: 5'TOP mRNAs
nodes.description: mRNAs with a 5'-terminal oligopyrimidine motif encoding ribosomal proteins, elongation factors and PABP; translationally repressed by LARP1 (and 4E-BPs) when mTORC1 is inactive.

nodes.label: tRNA
nodes.description: Pol III-transcribed transfer RNAs whose supply is scaled with ribosome production via mTORC1-MAF1 signalling.

nodes.label: VEGF-A
nodes.description: Angiogenic growth factor transcriptionally induced by HIF-1alpha and translationally dependent on eIF4E, linking mTORC1 output to the tumour angiogenic programme.

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1
nodes.description: SREBP1 target catalysing the committed, rate-limiting carboxylation of acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA in de novo lipogenesis.

nodes.label: ATF4
nodes.description: Integrated-stress-response transcription factor translated when eIF2alpha is phosphorylated; induces DDIT4 (REDD1) and SESN2, inhibiting mTORC1 under ER stress, energy stress and amino-acid starvation. Also an mTORC1 output.

nodes.label: ATG12–ATG5–ATG16L1 complex
nodes.description: E3-like conjugation machinery recruited to PI3P-positive phagophores by WIPI2; lipidates LC3/GABARAP proteins onto the expanding autophagosomal membrane.

nodes.label: ATG9A
nodes.description: The only transmembrane core autophagy protein; a lipid scramblase delivered in vesicles that seed the phagophore, trafficked under ULK1 control.

nodes.label: Beclin-1
nodes.description: Core subunit of class III PI3K complexes; ULK1 phosphorylation at Ser14 activates VPS34 lipid-kinase output for phagophore nucleation.

nodes.label: CAD
nodes.description: Trifunctional pyrimidine-synthesis enzyme; included here as an S6K1 substrate (Ser1859) to complete the S6K1 substrate set. Cross-reference to the metabolism module.

nodes.label: C/EBPβ (CEBPB)
nodes.description: Rhythmically expressed transcription factor that times the autophagy gene programme in liver; provides a mechanistic basis for rhythmic autophagic flux.

nodes.label: Fatty acid synthase
nodes.description: one of the lipogenic genes induced downstream of mTORC1–SREBP1.

nodes.label: G6PD
nodes.description: Rate-limiting enzyme of the oxidative pentose phosphate pathway, induced through SREBP downstream of mTORC1; supplies NADPH and ribose-5-phosphate.

nodes.label: glutamate dehydrogenase
nodes.description: Mitochondrial enzyme converting glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate for TCA anaplerosis; activated downstream of mTORC1-S6K1 through repression of SIRT4.

nodes.label: hexokinase 2
nodes.description: Mitochondria-associated hexokinase; an mTORC1/HIF-1 transcriptional output that, when free of glucose-6-phosphate during glucose deprivation, binds Raptor via a TOS-like motif and inhibits mTORC1 to promote autophagy.

nodes.label: HMG-CoA reductase
nodes.description: Rate-limiting enzyme of the mevalonate pathway and the principal SREBP2 target gene; the statin target, and the effector through which mTORC1–SREBP2 drives cholesterol synthesis.

nodes.label: IL-1alpha
nodes.description: Interleukin-1 alpha; mTORC1-dependent translation of IL1A is one of the two defined mechanisms by which mTORC1 is required for the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.

nodes.label: LDHA
nodes.description: Lactate dehydrogenase A, induced by HIF-1alpha; regenerates NAD+ by converting pyruvate to lactate and sustains aerobic glycolysis.

nodes.label: MTHFD2
nodes.description: Mitochondrial bifunctional methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase/cyclohydrolase of the folate cycle; ATF4-dependent induction couples one-carbon units to purine synthesis.

nodes.label: NADPH
nodes.description: Reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate; reductant generated by the oxidative pentose phosphate pathway and consumed by fatty-acid and sterol synthesis. It is a product of the mTORC1-SREBP-G6PD arm.

nodes.label: Nuclear respiratory factor 1
nodes.description: Transcription factor coactivated by PGC-1α that induces nuclear-encoded respiratory chain subunits and TFAM, supplying the missing mechanistic step between the YY1–PGC-1α complex and mitochondrial biogenesis.

nodes.label: PFKFB3
nodes.description: Bifunctional kinase/phosphatase producing fructose-2,6-bisphosphate, the allosteric activator of PFK1; induced by HIF-1alpha downstream of mTORC1.

nodes.label: Phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P)
nodes.description: Lipid product of the VPS34 (PIK3C3) complex I on the nascent phagophore; the signal that recruits PROPPIN/WIPI effectors and nucleates autophagosome formation.

nodes.label: Class III PI3K complex I
nodes.description: Autophagy-specific VPS34-Beclin-1-ATG14L-VPS15 complex that produces PI(3)P at the nascent phagophore.

nodes.label: PI3KC3 complex II (VPS34–Beclin-1–UVRAG)
nodes.description: UVRAG-containing class III PI3K complex, distinguished from ATG14L-containing complex I; acts in autophagosome maturation and endosomal trafficking rather than phagophore nucleation.

nodes.label: PKM2
nodes.description: M2 splice isoform of pyruvate kinase favoured in proliferating cells; its low-activity state permits accumulation of glycolytic intermediates for biosynthesis.

nodes.label: PPARgamma
nodes.description: Master adipogenic transcription factor; the PPARgamma programme is an adipose mTORC1-dependent output alongside adipogenesis.

nodes.label: PGC-1alpha
nodes.description: Transcriptional coactivator of mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative metabolism; its interaction with YY1 requires mTOR activity.

nodes.label: Ribose-5-phosphate
nodes.description: Pentose phosphate pathway product supplying the ribose backbone for de novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis.

nodes.label: Stearoyl-CoA desaturase 1
nodes.description: SREBP1 target introducing the Δ9 double bond into saturated fatty acyl-CoAs, required for membrane phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis.

nodes.label: SIRT4
nodes.description: Mitochondrial sirtuin that ADP-ribosylates and inhibits glutamate dehydrogenase; its expression is repressed downstream of mTORC1, de-repressing glutamine anaplerosis.

nodes.label: GLUT1
nodes.description: Facilitative glucose transporter induced by HIF-1alpha, raising glucose uptake downstream of mTORC1.

nodes.label: SREBP1
nodes.description: Membrane-bound transcription factor whose proteolytic processing and nuclear accumulation are promoted by mTORC1; drives fatty-acid synthesis genes and G6PD.

nodes.label: SREBP2
nodes.description: SREBP isoform controlling the sterol biosynthetic gene programme (HMGCR, HMGCS1, LDLR); mTOR is required for its transcriptional output, partly through rapamycin-resistant mechanisms.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial transcription factor A
nodes.description: Nuclear-encoded mtDNA packaging and transcription factor. Its translation is 4E-BP-sensitive, making it a concrete effector of the 4E-BP arm of mitochondrial biogenesis.

Phosphoserine/threonine-binding adaptor family; binds AMPK-phosphorylated Raptor, S6K1-phosphorylated Rictor and Thr246-phosphorylated PRAS40, translating phosphorylation of core subunits into sequestration or inhibition.

nodes.label: YY1
nodes.description: Zinc-finger transcription factor that partners PGC-1alpha at mitochondrial gene promoters in an mTOR-dependent, rapamycin-sensitive manner.

nodes.label: ZFP36L1
nodes.description: AU-rich-element RNA-binding protein that degrades cytokine transcripts; MK2 phosphorylation inactivates it, permitting SASP cytokine accumulation.

nodes.label: Na+/K+-ATPase (α1)
nodes.description: Basolateral sodium pump providing the driving force for transepithelial sodium reabsorption; stimulated downstream of SGK1.

nodes.label: BAD
nodes.description: Pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein; phosphorylation at human Ser99 (mouse Ser136) promotes 14-3-3 binding and suppresses its apoptotic activity.

nodes.label: p27 (CDKN1B)
nodes.description: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor; a FOXO1 transcriptional target. Elevated p27 accompanies nuclear FOXO1 accumulation in Rictor-null beta-cells and contributes to the reduced beta-cell mass seen on mTORC2 loss.

nodes.label: CLC-K chloride channels
nodes.description: Basolateral renal chloride channels (with barttin) required for transepithelial salt transport; positively regulated by SGK1.

nodes.label: FOXO1
nodes.description: Forkhead transcription factor; AKT phosphorylation (markedly enhanced by Ser473) causes 14-3-3 binding and nuclear exclusion, suppressing gluconeogenic and pro-apoptotic transcription.

nodes.label: FOXO3a
nodes.description: Forkhead transcription factor driving pro-apoptotic and stress-response genes; one of the AKT substrates whose phosphorylation depends disproportionately on mTORC2-mediated Ser473 phosphorylation.

nodes.label: Glucokinase
nodes.description: Hepatic hexokinase IV; induced downstream of hepatic mTORC2–AKT signalling and the entry point for hepatic glycolytic flux.

nodes.label: Hepatic gluconeogenesis
nodes.description: Hepatic de novo glucose production driven by FOXO1-dependent transcription; restrained by hepatic mTORC2 through AKT-mediated FOXO1 suppression.

nodes.label: MDM2 (E3 ubiquitin ligase)
